personal.name: Kritagya Khandelwal
personal.title: Software Engineer
personal.about: Software Engineer with expertise in Java, Python, Spring Boot, and distributed systems, currently building scalable backend platforms at a fintech unicorn, Yubi. Core contributor to the development of Yubi’s marketplace and Loan Operating System. Also, working on Agentic Layers for Orgwide AI Integration. I am a firm believer of self-written quote "Evolution is randomness seeking betterment" and therefore often found thinking about unprecedented possibilities.

experience.description: Now leading the platform side of things. Built a Context Graph layer that powers our agentic systems and made production debugging 3x faster. Designed a Bulk Framework that runs multi-million CSV requests reliably on Temporal, and a Data Collator aggregation engine that crunches millions of rows across 25+ microservices. Also re-engineered loan filtering from 3000ms to 350ms (P95), unblocking same-day processing for 10k+ loans. Bulk Framework and Data Collator now power 10+ services across 3 teams, and I run internal tech talks to spread the practices behind them.
Joined to build Yubi's Marketplace and Loan Operating System as microservices. Cut homepage latency by 5x with a CQRS setup and GraphQL aggregation.

Built backend services with FastAPI, PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ, and secured the product with OAuth 2.0 and RBAC. Also automated accessibility validation for auto-generated web pages by traversing DOM and CSSOM trees in Python.
Developed frontend with ReactJS and implemented real-time communication using socket.io. Created server-side APIs with Node.js, ExpressJS, MongoDB, and REST architecture.

Worked as a full-stack developer. Developed Facebook Instant Game from Scratch. Deployed backend webhook on AWS EC2 instance using apache server. Built Frontend using Javascript, JQuery, DOM with integrating Facebook Instant Games, Messanger APIs to the app, and made the app live for public users.

Worked on RHEL physical servers. Automated the OS installation with the help of anaconda file, Mount point syncing between two servers for critical data backups. Apache Server installation in RHEL 7 server and hosting a webpage.

Frameworks I have used: SpringBoot, FastAPI, ExpressJS and ROR. I have worked on multiple Database and messaging Queues: Postgres, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Kafka, RabbitMQ.
